[[File:Dr Gordon.png|thumb|250px|Dr. Gordon]] '''Dr. Gordon''' (Japanese: '''ドクター・ゴードン''' ''Dr. Gordon'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG142|Caterpie's Big Dilemma]]''. A scientist, Dr. Gordon operates a laboratory near [[Saffron City]] with his student, [[Zander]]. His specialty is making inventions based on Pokémon [[move]]s, and his lab is filled with a lot of them. Among them, there is a machine that enables him to use {{p|Alakazam}}'s {{m|Future Sight}} in order to predict the future, and a {{p|Machoke}} costume that gives the user ten times the strength. One of his accidental and untested inventions, the Mystery Candy Complete, was consumed by Zander's {{p|Caterpie}} after they fell onto the floor during {{TRT}}'s lab heist. The little Pokémon immediately grew in size and broke out of the lab. Seeing this, Team Rocket decided to kidnap Dr. Gordon so he could design technology for [[Team Rocket]]. Zander's Caterpie, meanwhile, had fully evolved into a {{p|Butterfree}}, which he and {{Ash}} used to save the doctor. After Butterfree shrunk back to its normal size, the doctor promised the city's [[Officer Jenny]] that he would keep his experiments inside the lab. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja= 長島雄一 ''Yūichi Nagashima'' |en=[[Wayne Grayson]] |es_la=Ernesto Lezama |es_eu=Miguel Ayones |fi=Bruno Lähteenmäki |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |pt_br=César Marchetti}}
